channel.title: UN Meetings Coverage and Press Releases

item.title: States Must Reaffirm Commitment to International Humanitarian Law as Conflict Evolves, Sixth Committee Hears
item.description: As armed conflict increases and evolves with the advent of new technologies, the Sixth Committee (Legal) continued today its debate on the status of the protocols additional to the Geneva Conventions, as speakers outlined national efforts to strengthen compliance with international law designed to protect those trapped by violence.
item.dc:creator: United Nations

item.title: Fuelled by Relentless Fighting, Drone Attacks, Sudan’s Conflict, Plight of Its People Remains Bleak, Political and Peacebuilding Affairs Chief Warns Security Council
item.description: The conflict and humanitarian crisis in Sudan continue to deteriorate without any visible breakthrough, Rosemary DiCarlo, Under-Secretary-General for Political and Peacebuilding Affairs, warned the Security Council today.
item.dc:creator: United Nations

item.title: Transparency, Confidence-Building Measures Take Centre Stage in First Committee Debate on Nuclear Weapons
item.description: Transparency and confidence-building measures emerged as a central theme in the First Committee’s (Disarmament and International Security) first day of thematic debates on nuclear weapons, as States underscored their value in reducing nuclear risks amid ongoing arsenal modernization, the erosion of arms-control frameworks, and rising political tensions.
item.dc:creator: United Nations

item.title: Senior United Nations Official Warns Second Committee of Catastrophic Destruction in Gaza, Escalating Israeli Settlement Activity
item.description: Escalating Israeli settler activity in the Palestinian territories and the Syrian Golan, along with the destruction of resources in Gaza represent an unprecedented catastrophe reversing “77 years of human development”, a senior United Nations official warned the Second Committee (Economic and Financial) today as it took up the issue of those lands.
item.dc:creator: United Nations
